result:
The newsletter sign-up is in place as a self-contained module. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (10 tests, 8 of them new), and `bunx guren check` and `bunx guren check --arch` report no failures.

I tested the boundary rule by temporarily adding a file under `app/` importing `modules/newsletter/index.ts` and one under `routes/` importing `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`. `guren check --arch` reported each as a failure; both probe files are removed.

Three things you might not expect:

- **The root `db/schema.ts` has one new line**, a re-export of the module's schema. The table definition itself lives only in `modules/newsletter/db/schema.ts`. This is the framework's convention, and `guren check` verifies the re-export is there.
- **The redirect only follows a `Referer` on the same host as the request.** Anything else goes to `/`, so the routes can't be used as an open redirect.
- **The migration is generated but not applied to the dev database.** `bun run db:migrate` shows it as pending and will apply it.

Emails are lowercased before storing. Following a confirmation link a second time keeps the original confirmation time.

**Summary of changes:** I scaffolded `modules/newsletter/` with the project's generators and filled it in: `index.ts` (module definition, `/newsletter` prefix), `routes.ts` (the three routes), `db/schema.ts` (the `newsletter_subscriptions` table), `app/Models/NewsletterSubscription.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/NewsletterValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/NewsletterController.ts`, and `tests/controllers/NewsletterController.test.ts`. Outside the module, `src/app.ts` registers it via `modules: [newsletterModule]`, `db/schema.ts` re-exports the module schema, `db/migrations/20260929145435_create_newsletter_subscriptions/` holds the new migration, `tsconfig.json` includes `modules/**/*`, and the generated `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` were regenerated. A new `guren.arch.ts` at the project root forbids anything under `app/` or `routes/` from importing `modules/newsletter/**`, type-only imports included. Nothing under `app/` or `routes/` was touched.
